## Measured: the blast radius, and a correction to this issue's own numbers

Implemented on [`fix/tool-surface-partiality`](https://github.com/lets-order-some-fries/trovark/tree/fix/tool-surface-partiality)
and measured across the whole published index — 381 of the 400 refs (19 repos 404 today,
renamed or deleted since the 2026-08-15 scan). Every flip was hand-checked against a clone,
and each before/after was re-run through the real CLI on both branches within the same hour,
so the numbers isolate the fix from repo drift.

| | |
|---|---|
| Flip to `surfacePartial` | **5** of 381 |
| Published grades that change | **4** |
| Grades newly withheld (INSUFFICIENT DATA) | **1** (`alexar76/aimarket-plugins`, B- 72) |
| Graded cards | **310 → 309** |
| Refs where the existing `tools/` guard stopped firing | **0** |

The five: `github/github-mcp-server`, `alexar76/aimarket-plugins`, `gupta-kush/spotify-mcp`,
`Octodamus/octodamus-core`, `smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go`.

### This issue's ground truth was wrong

I said "125 tools, 34 destructive". Counted at HEAD `7d13a7a`: **121** distinct tool names
(121 golden files in `pkg/github/__toolsnaps__/`), **61** annotated `readOnlyHint: false`, and
**14** hard create/delete/push/merge/fork verbs. The shape of the problem is unchanged — 4 tools
read of 121 — but the numbers should be quoted correctly.

### Withholding a number is not grade-neutral

Cost carries weight 0.15, so withholding a *below-average* cost score **raises** the weighted
mean of what remains. Two of the five move up: `gupta-kush/spotify-mcp` goes C- 55 → C 61. That
is worth a changelog line, because "we declined to answer" reading as "better grade" is
surprising.

### One false positive was found and fixed

`daedalusdevelopmentgroup/ddg-agent-payable-services` flipped because a 25-line package
`__init__.py` — docstring, `__version__`, a lazy `__getattr__`, zero tool declarations — went
unread beside the two files that declare all 43 of its tools. Its surface was complete, and the
punishment was a reward: B 79 → A- 86. Files that cannot declare a tool are now excluded from
the candidate set. Re-derived over all 400 cached decision inputs: flips 6 → 5, that ref is the
only one suppressed, all five true positives survive.

### Why this should not close the issue

**`github/github-mcp-server` still publishes A+ 96 after the fix.** It gains the partial-read
note and loses a cost number it did not need — cost was 100/100 and the other three dimensions
already averaged 96. Security stays **85**, computed from a `toolSurfaceRisk` of `low` inferred
from four read-only getters out of 121 tools, 61 of them non-read-only, because `assemble.ts`
drops the risk only when it is exactly `none`.

So the partiality detection is right and worth landing, but the headline harm this issue was
filed about — the README's flagship example grading A+ on a 4-of-121 read — survives it. The
question that actually moves that card is whether **security should be withheld on a partial
surface at all**, which is a rubric-shaped decision rather than a detection bug.

Suggest landing this branch as the detection half and keeping the issue open for that.
